after:
# Asset-Agnostic Policy

**Last Updated:** 2026-05-17
**Status:** Active

## Body

RtB optimizes allocation to a user-curated portfolio of two or more risky assets plus risk-free cash. The deprecated two-asset model is retained for legacy comparison surfaces only.

label.rationale: Doctrine body materially rewrites the asset model (two-asset → user-curated multi-asset). content-doctrine.rdg's doctrine-health pass MUST re-run; this is exactly the kind of doctrine evolution that downstream audits depend on knowing about.

graderNotes: Real doctrinal change. Even if S11 predicate is uncertain, must default to re-run on doctrine-body diffs.
